The '''Eberon&ndash;Kashyyyk War''' was a conflict fought between the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and the [[Eberon system/Legends|Eberon system]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> in the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The conflict was ended sometime between [[3653 BBY]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and [[3651 BBY]]<ref name="Gnost" /> by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]], who personally intervened in the war to bring it to an end.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Eberon&ndash;Kashyyyk War was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', under the "Major Achievements" section of Satele Shan's entry.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
